steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Engineering creates both positive and negative impacts on society, the economy and the environment. | Key Fact: Positive social impacts: improved infrastructure, medical devices, communication technology and housing. | Key Fact: Negative social impacts: noise pollution, traffic congestion, community displacement and digital divide. | Key Fact: Positive economic impacts: job creation, export revenue, technology spin-offs and improved productivity.
